summary: One is an index finger held up, palm facing you when counting, palm out when giving an age or a count to someone.
steps: Palm toward you to count, palm out to show someone.
Keep it small and in front of your chest.
mistakes: Pushing the number out toward the listener. It stays near your body.

faq.q: Why does the palm face me?
faq.a: Numbers one through five face you when you're counting or listing. They face out when the number is an age, a time, or a quantity you're telling someone.
